**Likely function:** acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC) carboxyltransferase component, associated with **EC 2.1.3.15**.

**Reaction catalyzed:**

*N⁶-carboxybiotinyl-L-lysyl-[biotin-carrier protein] + acetyl-CoA ⇌ N⁶-biotinyl-L-lysyl-[biotin-carrier protein] + malonyl-CoA*

In other words, this component transfers the carboxyl group carried by carboxybiotin to acetyl-CoA, producing malonyl-CoA. It catalyzes the transfer step of ACC; the full ACC complex also uses ATP to carboxylate biotin.

**Evidence:** The 560-aa sequence is highly similar across most of its length to reviewed ACC carboxyltransferase references (up to 60.8% identity and 95.5% query coverage). The assignment is therefore supported by homology, not direct experimental characterization of this exact sequence.
